listings.name: JARS by Fabio Viviani — Emeryville
listings.label: JARS Emeryville
listings.cuisine: Dessert shop, ice cream and catering
listings.tagline: Layered dessert jars, soft serve, shakes and Bay Area dessert catering from the Bay Street shop.
listings.contactOnly: Check the Emeryville menu for the current shop flavors, or use the catering form to request pickup or delivery.

panels.head: Dessert catering
body: The 8-pack contains full-size dessert jars. The 12-pack is a mini assortment with three each of four flavors. Pickup is at Bay Street. Delivery areas, minimums and service fees are listed on the catering form.

sections.name: Catering packs
items: Eight individually lidded 6 oz desserts. Choose available flavors when the order is confirmed.
Twelve individually lidded 2 oz desserts: banana cream pie, Oreo cookies & cream, tiramisu and salted caramel brownie.

listings.name: Lemon Crab — Richmond
listings.label: Lemon Crab
listings.tagline: Cajun seafood boils and garlic noodles at Lemon Crab’s downtown Richmond location.
listings.contactOnly: Call the Richmond location for current hours and prices.

panels.head: Seafood boils
body: The Richmond review shows king crab, Dungeness crab and garlic noodles. Call this location for the current menu.

panels.head: Locations
body: The Mission Boulevard restaurant has its own BEASTY page, menu and contact details.

listings.name: OH CRAB!
listings.label: OH CRAB!
listings.tagline: Seafood by the pound, with a choice of sauce and heat, on Telegraph Avenue in Temescal.
listings.contactOnly: Seafood follows market pricing. Ask the restaurant for current prices and availability.

panels.head: Build a seafood boil
body: Choose shrimp, crawfish, snow crab, king crab, Dungeness, lobster, clams or mussels. The kitchen offers signature, Cajun, garlic butter, lemon pepper and Cajun cream sauces.

panels.head: Sides and plates
body: Choose bag additions like corn, potatoes, sausage, egg or broccoli. The menu also lists oysters, seafood ramyeon, clam chowder, garlic noodles, shrimp baskets and a kids’ meal.

panels.head: Oakland takeout
body: Call to order for pickup on Telegraph Avenue.

posts.credit: Published by @jarsemeryville as an introduction to the Emeryville shop.
